has filed chargesheet against Accused no.1 for the offences punishable U/s. 498A of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Tasmiya Taj.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused No.1 married CW-1 on 29-04- 2021.
At the time of marriage, the accused No.1 to 3 have demanded and taken 40 gms of gold and gold jewelery to CW-1 as dowry on the guise of being Gift.

After the marriage, the accused No.1 subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty in respect of getting a Car worth Rs.10 lakhs and also bringing additional dowry of Rs.10 Lakhs from her parents and when CW-1 refused to do so,
the accused No.1 on 01-09-2022 have abused her in filthy  3  C.C.No.2981/2022 language and threatened her with dire consequences and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty in demand of additional dowry.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.313/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Basavanagudi women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.

Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were Tasmiya Taj vs Abu Sufiyan on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163919782/
2 enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 to 3 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 to 3 after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to him, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused No.1 to 3 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.
As there were no any incriminating circumstances in the evidence against the accused, the statement of accused as required U/s.313 of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.498A, 504, 506 of IPC. &
Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act..?
 2) what order?
 8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked  5  C.C.No.2981/2022 Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.

is the first information statement.

10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Tasmiya Taj.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 26-07-2015 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused, assaulted her and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.

11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is Tasmiya Taj vs Abu Sufiyan on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163919782/
4 apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness  6  C.C.No.2981/2022 have turned hostile to the prosecution case.

sentences.text: Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 to 3 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER In exercise of power conferred Under are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A of IPC. &
Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.1 to 3 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
